notes.title: Patch 2022.12.01 - Rebalance and new BOSS
notes.content: Improved overall game balance to make it more fun to play. New monsters and bosses have been added. Upgrading weapons will make it easier to fight bosses. You can "Rebirth" to get stat bonuses.

notes.title: Game Update - 2020.08.25
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36076447/ff58e01b1a33568cbe957191264ee0bb07d7cb43.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone. This is a regular update that I would like to announce. A new boss has been added with new abilities. You can craft purple bottles to remove debuffs. The game has added effects to look even more beautiful.

notes.title: Game Update - 2020.05.10
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36076447/7f657e98b41dd272629e7c91350ec4b89de73d32.png[/img]

Hello everyone. This is a little update that I would like to announce.
[list][*][b]Bell Button[/b] - Call all the workers back to the castle [i](Shotcut: B)[/i]
[*][b]Building: Cannon[/b] - Increase base Attack Speed from 3.0s/hit to 1.5s/hit.
[*][b]Building: Turret[/b] - Change target to attack only the flying enemies, Increased attack range from 80 meters to 100 meters, Increase base Attack Speed from 1.0s/hit to 0.8s/hit.
[*][b]Archer[/b] - Increased wage price from 200W 100F 100O 100G to 500W 250F 250O 250G.
[*][b]Gunner[/b] - Increased wage price from 100W 100F 200O 100G to 250W 250F 500O 250G, Damage reduced from 350% to 180%, Bullet can shoot through all enemies.
[*][b]Guard[/b] - Increase base damage from 70% to 150% and increase base hit point (HPt) from 60 to 100
[*][b]Knight[/b] - Increase base damage from 120% to 350% and increase base hit point (HPt) from 40 to 60
[*][b]Skill: Tornado[/b] - Area of effect changed from 40m > 60m > 80m > 100m to 40m > 55m > 70m > 85m.
[*][b]Skill: Iceberg[/b] - Area of effect changed from 50m > 75m > 100m > 125m to 55m > 70m > 85m > 100m.
[*][b]Skill: Thunderbolt[/b] - (New Skill) Causing severe damage and mini stun in the target area.
[*][b]New Boss & Monster[/b] - Added bosses and monsters in the game. Including new skills
[/list]
[b]Reset Game[/b] - You can reset to start a new game from the options menu. [i](Please note that your save file information will be lost. Because the system will create a new save file.)[/i]
